organization.zh: GenAI SQL and ShortQuest System, Hong Kong Polytechnic University
organization.en: GenAI SQL and ShortQuest System, Hong Kong Polytechnic University

heroCardDescription.zh: assessment、feedback、revision 与 analytics 的教学闭环
heroCardDescription.en: A teaching loop across assessment, feedback, revision, and analytics

heroSummary.zh: 这是我最适合在面试主讲的项目：一个 AI-supported SQL learning platform，不只是 grading，而是把 assessment、feedback、revision 和 analytics 做成闭环。
heroSummary.en: This is the strongest project for me to present in an interview: an AI-supported SQL learning platform that goes beyond grading by connecting assessment, feedback, revision, and analytics into a learning loop.

cardHighlights.zh: 支持学生多次尝试 SQL / MongoDB-style task，并返回结构化 feedback，而不是只有一次性分数
cardHighlights.en: Supported repeated attempts for SQL and MongoDB-style tasks with structured feedback instead of one-off scoring

cardHighlights.zh: 系统覆盖 student flow、admin / teaching flow、learning records 与 analytics，不只是 isolated demo
cardHighlights.en: Covered student flow, admin and teaching flow, learning records, and analytics instead of remaining an isolated demo

cardHighlights.zh: 近期 repo 工作体现了 domain services 拆分、analytics refinement 与 frontend admin API consolidation
cardHighlights.en: Recent repo work shows domain service splitting, analytics refinement, and frontend admin API consolidation

value.zh: 传统 SQL 学习里，学生常常只能拿到分数，却难以知道哪里错、为什么错，也很难回看自己是否真的进步。
value.en: In traditional SQL learning, students often receive a score without understanding what went wrong, why it went wrong, or whether they have actually improved over time.

value.zh: 做一个支持 SQL / NoSQL formative assessment 的完整教学平台，让学生可反复尝试，教师也能获得 learning records 和 analytics。
value.en: Build a complete teaching platform for SQL and NoSQL formative assessment, supporting repeated student attempts while also giving educators learning records and analytics.

value.zh: 系统最终覆盖 student flow、grading orchestration、learning records、admin flow 与 analytics，成为真正可用于 teaching and learning reporting 的平台。
value.en: The system ultimately covered student flow, grading orchestration, learning records, admin flow, and analytics, becoming a platform that supports real teaching and learning reporting.

items.zh: 围绕 student solving flow、grading orchestration、learning records 和 analytics 做全栈协同，而不是只做一个 isolated frontend demo。
items.en: Worked across the student solving flow, grading orchestration, learning records, and analytics instead of building an isolated frontend demo.

items.zh: 参与 backend service modularization、API consistency、NoSQL support tightening 等工作，让系统在演进中仍然可维护。
items.en: Contributed to backend service modularization, API consistency, and tighter NoSQL support so the platform remained maintainable as it evolved.

items.zh: 把提交结果进一步转成 learning records 和 analytics，确保系统对学生和教师两端都有持续价值。
items.en: Extended submission results into learning records and analytics so the platform delivers ongoing value to both students and educators.

items.zh: 它符合 educational technology 场景里最关键的要求：不是只自动评分，而是支持 feedback、revision、reflection 和 teaching insight。
items.en: It matches the most important educational technology requirement: not just automatic grading, but support for feedback, revision, reflection, and teaching insight.

items.zh: 项目同时覆盖 frontend、backend、database、AI integration 和 analytics，能完整展示 full-stack thinking。
items.en: The project spans frontend, backend, database, AI integration, and analytics, which makes it a strong demonstration of full-stack thinking.

caption.zh: 这一张图把 student/admin user、Nuxt frontend、Flask API、domain services、PostgreSQL、Redis 和 LLM layer 的关系压缩在一起。
caption.en: This chart compresses the relationship between student/admin users, the Nuxt frontend, Flask API, domain services, PostgreSQL, Redis, and the LLM layer.

caption.zh: 重点不是“模型给分”，而是学生如何通过多次尝试和反馈形成真正的学习闭环。
caption.en: The key is not 'the model gives a score', but how students form a real learning loop through repeated attempts and feedback.

caption.zh: 这部分让平台从 student tool 升级为真正的 teaching platform。
caption.en: This is the layer that upgrades the system from a student tool into a real teaching platform.
